ruleCategories.NEAR_SYNONYM: Closely related meaning, commonly explicitly contrasted in HSK1 teaching (e.g. hui4/neng2/ke3yi3).
ruleCategories.MORPHOLOGICAL_SUFFIX: Shares a productive bound grammatical suffix/allomorph (e.g. pronoun + men).
ruleCategories.COMPOSITIONAL_COMPOUND: One word is directly formed by compounding with the other (e.g. du2 + shu1 = du2shu1).
ruleCategories.COMPOUND_FAMILY: Shares a productive head/root morpheme forming a recognized HSK1 word-formation family (e.g. hao3+chi1/kan4/ting1/wan2r).
ruleCategories.CLOSED_PARADIGM: Member of the same small, closed grammatical or semantic paradigm (e.g. zuo2tian1/jin1tian1/ming2tian1).
ruleCategories.FUNCTIONAL_CONTEXT: Real-world functional, collocational, or discourse-adjacency relationship (e.g. xie4xie/bu2ke4qi, chuan1/yi1fu).
ruleCategories.GENDER_PAIR: Male/female counterpart within a defined lexical pair (e.g. nan2peng2you/nu:3peng2you).
ruleCategories.CONTRAST: Age/role contrast pair within a closed kinship set (e.g. ge1ge/di4di).

scopeNote: Pilot scope: all candidates in this artifact are HSK1-internal (every wordId belongs to hsk1_vocabulary_production.json), even though the candidate universe spans HSK1-6 per the approved CROSS_LEVEL_HSK1_TO_HSK6 policy. This is a deliberate, documented scope decision for the pilot, not a silent limitation -- see the P5.4.1 report.
